description: This file defines the 'Answer' class, which is a JPA entity representing answers linked to questions in a database. It includes annotations for ORM mapping, serialization control, and sequence generation, and it provides getter and setter methods for its fields.

classes.name: Answer
classes.description: A JPA entity class representing an answer, with fields for id, text, and associated question, extending AuditModel for auditing features.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the answer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the answer.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the answer.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the answer.

methods.name: setQuestion
methods.description: Associates this answer with a Question object.
